payload.title: Brand pack format and validator
payload.description:
What: a JSON brand pack: name, logo, role colours for light and dark, fonts from an allow-list, sections, nav, home template, plus an image-style slot (links PPY-1f68bf) that accepts still pictograms. A validator applies the platform policy. Versioned schema.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A valid pack builds a branded site
  Given a pack with its own colours and font from the allow-list
  When the site builds in light and dark
  Then the brand shows and the policy checks pass
Scenario: A font outside the allow-list is rejected
